name: is-a-plan
points: The output proposes one concrete change and names the files it edits.
The output says where a reopened session's transcript comes from after the change.

name: leaves-the-model-thread-alone
points: The plan changes no file under lib/runtime/.
The plan adds no parameter or option to a public stdlib function such as userMessage or llm.
The plan leaves the messages the model is sent as they are: it does not split a message into several, move text between messages, or add a mark to messages.
The transcript comes from something recorded as each turn happens, and is not rebuilt by filtering or marking the messages on the conversation thread.
Under the plan, a kind of model-only message that someone adds later stays out of the transcript without anyone marking it.
